title: Singular equivalences and homological conjectures
summary: The fact that each finite-dimensional algebra over a field is isomorphic to the centralizer of two matrices, has suggested to investigate representation theoretical problems of finite-dimensional algebras through the centralizer algebras of matrices. Therefore the first natural question is to study the problems for the centralizer algebra of one matrix, called a centralizer matrix algebra. In this paper we give an elementary and explicit approach to the singularity categories and singular equivalences of centralizer matrix algebras, and verify the Auslander--Reiten and Cartan determinant…
